summary: Sprint 2 end-to-end verification: refactor (briefings/learn routers), sub-committees, simulate, comments+@mentions. 18/19 backend tests passed (1 skipped because no briefings exist in NED context — expected). Frontend: all required data-testids present on Highlights, Briefings, and Simulate pages; Simulate page renders rail, hypothesis input, horizon select, run button, splash and 3 starter buttons. Committee chips show with correct slug ids (audit-committee, risk-committee, nominations-committee). Left-nav 'Simulate' link is present. LLM simulate call completed in ~30s returning full 1y/3y/watchlist/assumptions/question_for_management. @mention resolution correctly resolved 'Test Executive' via first-name 'test' on a comment authored by Bramuel in the Tuli Exec context after inviting exec.test@akki.ai.

issues: The 'Heads up' role-mismatch banner (Executive role vs NED context) renders at the top of the Simulate page for Bramuel, same as other surfaces — pre-existing behaviour from iteration 3, not Sprint-2-introduced. Worth confirming that activeRole auto-routes correctly once the user opens a simulation.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still 1570 lines — further extraction candidates: documents (~170 lines), signals/ask (~260 lines), telemetry+audit+export (~150 lines). Not blocking but would bring the file under the 700-line ideal.

routers/comments.py _resolve_mentions is O(N_members) — fine at current scale. Note it resolves by equality only; does not dedupe @tokens against body position, and if two users share the same first name both resolve. Acceptable for M5.

routers/simulate.py — no size/validation on signals fetched when body.signal_ids is very long. Limited to 8 via to_list(8) which is effectively a hard cap; could explicitly reject >20 signal ids upfront to save a DB round-trip.
Startup backfill for committee slug ids (server.py lines 1498-1509) correctly idempotent; committees with existing id are left untouched. Good.

DocumentViewer comment-thread component wiring not tested end-to-end in this run (no exec-context docs visible to Bramuel via /app/workspace — test comment was posted on a signal instead, which exercised the same artefact-polymorphic endpoint). Main agent can self-verify by uploading a doc and commenting on it.
